provenance.scope: Original seven component-role rows. Renderer regression only, not a new model response or complete acceptance.

rows.c1: Renders UI, holds the user's Supabase session, calls Next.js routes and user-scoped Supabase queries.
rows.c2: Supabase publishable key + user access token; Next.js session cookie.

rows.c1: Server rendering, server actions, route handlers, privileged operations, Stripe API calls, webhook receipt.
rows.c2: Supabase server client (user token or service role); Stripe secret key; webhook signing secret.

rows.c1: Issues and refreshes user sessions; provides the authenticated user ID.
rows.c2: JWT access token consumed by browser and Next.js; user ID used to look up membership.

rows.c1: Stores tenants, memberships, business data; enforces row-level access per role.
rows.c2: Policies bind `tenant_id` to current membership; user-scoped queries run under the authenticated role.

rows.c1: Stores tenant files; per-object access control.
rows.c2: Storage policies keyed on tenant path prefix and membership.

rows.c1: Collects payment, manages subscriptions, invoices, customer portal.
rows.c2: Server-created Checkout Sessions and Subscription objects; `customer` and `subscription` IDs mapped to tenants.

rows.c1: Notifies the app of billing state changes.
rows.c2: Signed POST to a Next.js route handler; event ID deduplicated and effects committed atomically.
